from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
OUT = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-attention-package-check")
RECEIPT = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/package-attention-verification.json"
TOOLING_AUDIT = (
    ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-observer-local-review.json"
)
TOOLING_RECEIPT = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/engine-attention-observer-verification.json"
AUDIT_SHA256 = "4d4f5640291983e740ae01702d04caa51e2d60804ab5e7447bf0ddb4da13eee0"
DECLARATION = (
    ROOT
    / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-source-declaration-v2-20261005.json"
)
DECLARATION_SHA256 = "589a45fe5f941d13311ec2668889186fd14557cc173071c0de3e0cea333dfe8f"
RELOCATION = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-fp32-b1-audit-relocation.json"
BUILD = [
    "/Users/teilomillet/.local/bin/uv",
    "build",
    "--offline",
    "--cache-dir",
    "/private/tmp/wyat-uv-build-cache",
    "--python",
    str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"),
    "--no-python-downloads",
    "--out-dir",
    str(OUT),
    "--no-create-gitignore",
    str(ROOT),
]
ATTENTION = (
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/__init__.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/run.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/scorer.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/study.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/trace.py",
    "tests/analysis/test_cuda_attention.py",
)

ISOLATED = """from __future__ import annotations
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
import wyat
import wyat.interop.dmbench
from wyat.core import Candidate, Model, Request
from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, evaluate

class ControlledScorer:
    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]:
        return tuple((0.0, 1.0) for _ in requests)

request = Request('question', (Candidate('a', 'first'), Candidate('b', 'second')))
model = Model(ControlledScorer(), 'package-check')
decision = model.decide(request)
assert decision.selected == 'b'
assert evaluate(model, (EvaluationCase('one', request, ('b',)),)).accuracy == 1.0
blocked = {'torch', 'mlx', 'mlx_lm', 'transformers', 'huggingface_hub',
           'fastapi', 'dmbench', 'safetensors'}
assert not blocked.intersection(name.split('.')[0] for name in sys.modules)
print(json.dumps({'wyat_path': wyat.__file__, 'selected': decision.selected,
                  'forbidden_import_roots': sorted(blocked),
                  'forbidden_imports_present': []}))
"""


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha(path.read_bytes())


def inventory(paths: list[Path]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in sorted(paths)}


def source_paths() -> list[Path]:
    return [
        path
        for directory in ("wyat", "benchmarks", "tests")
        for path in (ROOT / directory).rglob("*.py")
        if not forbidden(str(path))
    ]


def document_paths() -> list[Path]:
    documents = [
        ROOT / "pyproject.toml",
        ROOT / "README.md",
        ROOT / "NOTICE",
        ROOT / "LICENSE",
        ROOT / "open-question.md",
        ROOT / "wyat/py.typed",
    ]
    documents.extend((ROOT / "docs").rglob("*.md"))
    admitted_xml = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/mlx-metal-first8-toc.xml"
    if admitted_xml.exists():
        documents.append(admitted_xml)
    if RELOCATION.exists():
        relocation = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(RELOCATION.read_bytes()))
        files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], relocation["files"])
        documents.append(RELOCATION)
        for entry in files:
            archive = ROOT / cast(str, entry["archive_path"])
            assert digest(archive) == entry["sha256"]
            assert archive.stat().st_size == entry["bytes"]
            documents.append(archive)
        review = cast(dict[str, str], relocation["immutable_review"])
        review_path = ROOT / review["path"]
        assert digest(review_path) == review["sha256"]
        documents.append(review_path)
    if TOOLING_AUDIT.exists():
        audit = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_AUDIT.read_bytes()))
        auditor = cast(dict[str, str], audit["audit_script"])
        auditor_path = Path(auditor["path"])
        assert digest(auditor_path) == auditor["sha256"]
        documents.extend((TOOLING_AUDIT, auditor_path, TOOLING_RECEIPT, DECLARATION))
        receipt = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_RECEIPT.read_bytes()))
        tooling_archive_record = cast(dict[str, str], receipt["source_archive"])
        tooling_archive_path = Path(tooling_archive_record["path"])
        assert digest(tooling_archive_path) == tooling_archive_record["sha256"]
        documents.append(tooling_archive_path)
    return documents


def forbidden(name: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(name)
    parts = path.parts
    return (
        any(part.endswith((".trace", ".gputrace")) for part in parts)
        or any(part in {".models", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__"} for part in parts)
        or name.endswith(".raw.xml")
        or path.suffix.lower()
        in {
            ".safetensors",
            ".pt",
            ".pth",
            ".onnx",
            ".bin",
            ".pyc",
            ".pyo",
        }
    )


def command_record(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "command": result.args,
        "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout,
        "stderr": result.stderr,
    }


def main() -> None:
    if RECEIPT.exists() or OUT.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve prior receipts and build directories")
    script_checks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for args in (
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "check", __file__],
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "format", "--check", __file__],
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/mypy"), "--strict", "--follow-imports=skip", __file__],
    ):
        checked = subprocess.run(
            args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
        )
        script_checks.append(command_record(checked))
        assert checked.returncode == 0, checked.stdout + checked.stderr
    production = sorted((ROOT / "wyat").rglob("*.py"))
    expected = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): path.read_bytes() for path in production}
    assert len(expected) == 20
    prior_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/package-engine-tooling-verification.json"
    prior = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(prior_path.read_text()))
    assert inventory(production) == prior["production_source_sha256"]
    assert digest(TOOLING_AUDIT) == AUDIT_SHA256
    tooling_audit = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_AUDIT.read_bytes()))
    assert tooling_audit["passed"] is True
    assert tooling_audit["source_count"] == 129
    assert tooling_audit["production_files_unchanged"] == 20
    assert tooling_audit["frameworks_imported"] == []
    auditor = cast(dict[str, str], tooling_audit["audit_script"])
    tooling_auditor = Path(auditor["path"])
    assert digest(tooling_auditor) == auditor["sha256"]
    assert sha(auditor["text"].encode()) == auditor["sha256"]
    artifacts = cast(dict[str, str], tooling_audit["artifact_sha256"])
    assert digest(TOOLING_RECEIPT) == artifacts[str(TOOLING_RECEIPT)]
    tooling = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_RECEIPT.read_bytes()))
    maintained = cast(dict[str, str], tooling["source_sha256"])
    assert len(maintained) == 129
    assert inventory([ROOT / name for name in maintained]) == maintained
    archive_record = cast(dict[str, str], tooling["source_archive"])
    source_archive = Path(archive_record["path"])
    assert digest(source_archive) == archive_record["sha256"]
    assert archive_record["sha256"] == tooling_audit["archive_sha256"]
    archive_values = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(source_archive.read_bytes()))
    archived_sources = cast(list[dict[str, str]], archive_values["files"])
    assert len(archived_sources) == 129
    assert {entry["path"] for entry in archived_sources} == maintained.keys()
    for source_entry in archived_sources:
        assert sha(source_entry["text"].encode()) == maintained[source_entry["path"]]
        assert source_entry["sha256"] == maintained[source_entry["path"]]
    assert digest(DECLARATION) == DECLARATION_SHA256
    declaration = cast(dict[str, str], json.loads(DECLARATION.read_bytes()))
    assert set(declaration) == {*ATTENTION, "docs/analysis/attention.md"}
    assert {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in ATTENTION} == {
        name: declaration[name] for name in ATTENTION
    }
    sources, documents = source_paths(), document_paths()
    before = inventory(sources + documents)
    for name in ATTENTION:
        assert name in before
    preserved_paths = list((ROOT / "benchmarks/real").glob("package*verification*"))
    preserved_paths.extend(
        path for path in (ROOT / "dist").rglob("*") if path.is_file()
    )
    preserved = inventory(preserved_paths)
    OUT.mkdir()
    build = subprocess.run(BUILD, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    (OUT / "build.stdout").write_text(build.stdout)
    (OUT / "build.stderr").write_text(build.stderr)
    assert build.returncode == 0, build.stderr
    assert inventory(source_paths() + document_paths()) == before, (
        "Source changed during build"
    )
    assert inventory(preserved_paths) == preserved, "Historical bytes changed"
    (wheel,) = OUT.glob("*.whl")
    (sdist,) = OUT.glob("*.tar.gz")
    checks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
        wheel_names = archive.namelist()
        assert not [name for name in wheel_names if forbidden(name)]
        assert {
            name
            for name in wheel_names
            if name.startswith("wyat/") and name.endswith(".py")
        } == expected.keys()
        for name, data in expected.items():
            assert archive.read(name) == data, name
        assert archive.read("wyat/py.typed") == (ROOT / "wyat/py.typed").read_bytes()
        for name in ("NOTICE", "LICENSE"):
            (entry,) = (
                item for item in wheel_names if item.endswith("/licenses/" + name)
            )
            assert archive.read(entry) == (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
            prefix="wyat-attention-isolated-", dir="/private/tmp"
        ) as isolated:
            archive.extractall(isolated)
            environment = {
                **os.environ,
                "PYTHONPATH": isolated,
                "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
            }
            for args in (
                [sys.executable, "-S", "-c", ISOLATED],
                [sys.executable, "-S", "-m", "wyat", "--help"],
            ):
                checked = subprocess.run(
                    args,
                    cwd=isolated,
                    env=environment,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=15,
                )
                checks.append(command_record(checked))
                assert checked.returncode == 0, checked.stderr
            assert "usage: wyat" in cast(str, checks[-1]["stdout"])
    with tarfile.open(sdist, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = archive.getnames()
        assert not [name for name in members if forbidden(name)]
        prefix = members[0].split("/")[0]
        for name, expected_hash in before.items():
            member = archive.extractfile(f"{prefix}/{name}")
            assert member is not None, name
            assert sha(member.read()) == expected_hash, name
    assert inventory(source_paths() + document_paths()) == before, (
        "Source changed during verification"
    )
    assert inventory(preserved_paths) == preserved, "Historical bytes changed"
    script = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    archive_data: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "files": [
            {
                "name": "verification_script",
                "path": str(Path(__file__)),
                "sha256": sha(script),
                "text": script.decode("utf-8"),
            },
            {
                "name": "independent_tooling_auditor",
                "path": str(tooling_auditor),
                "sha256": digest(tooling_auditor),
                "text": tooling_auditor.read_text(),
            },
            {
                "name": "independent_tooling_audit",
                "path": str(TOOLING_AUDIT),
                "sha256": digest(TOOLING_AUDIT),
                "text": TOOLING_AUDIT.read_text(),
            },
            {
                "name": "corrected_source_declaration",
                "path": str(DECLARATION),
                "sha256": digest(DECLARATION),
                "text": DECLARATION.read_text(),
            },
            *[
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "path": str(ROOT / name),
                    "sha256": before[name],
                    "text": (ROOT / name).read_text(),
                }
                for name in ATTENTION
            ],
        ],
    }
    archive_bytes = (
        json.dumps(archive_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
    ).encode()
    archive_hash = sha(archive_bytes)
    archive_name = f"package-attention-verification.sources-{archive_hash[:16]}.json"
    archive_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real" / archive_name
    with archive_path.open("xb") as output:
        output.write(archive_bytes)
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "scope": (
            "CPU-only offline local packaging verification; "
            "no publication or device/framework execution"
        ),
        "build": command_record(build),
        "wheel": {
            "path": str(wheel),
            "sha256": digest(wheel),
            "bytes": wheel.stat().st_size,
            "members": wheel_names,
        },
        "sdist": {
            "path": str(sdist),
            "sha256": digest(sdist),
            "bytes": sdist.stat().st_size,
            "member_count": len(members),
            "members": members,
        },
        "production_python_files": len(expected),
        "production_source_sha256": inventory(production),
        "inventoried_python_source_count": len(sources),
        "source_and_document_sha256": before,
        "attention_source_sha256": {name: before[name] for name in ATTENTION},
        "project_config_sha256": before["pyproject.toml"],
        "notice_sha256": before["NOTICE"],
        "license_sha256": before["LICENSE"],
        "verification_script_sha256": sha(script),
        "verification_script_checks": script_checks,
        "independent_tooling_byte_audit": tooling_audit,
        "corrected_source_declaration": {
            "path": str(DECLARATION.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": digest(DECLARATION),
            "declared_sha256": declaration,
            "six_python_sources_match": True,
            "current_attention_doc_sha256": before["docs/analysis/attention.md"],
            "documentation_scope": (
                "Declaration pins prospective screen documentation. Final docs may "
                "append terminal observations, captured separately in this package."
            ),
        },
        "cuda_b1_auditor_relocation": (
            None
            if not RELOCATION.exists()
            else {
                "path": str(RELOCATION.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": digest(RELOCATION),
                "mapping": json.loads(RELOCATION.read_bytes()),
                "mapped_archive_bytes_and_review_hash_verified": True,
            }
        ),
        "verification_script_archive": {
            "path": str(archive_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": archive_hash,
        },
        "previous_receipts_and_dist_sha256": preserved,
        "isolated_checks": checks,
        "all_production_bytes_match": True,
        "sdist_current_sources_and_docs_match": True,
        "typed_marker_and_notice_license_match": True,
        "wheel_and_sdist_no_weights_raw_capture_raw_xml_tensors_venv": True,
        "admitted_sanitized_xml_members": [
            name for name in members if name.endswith(".xml")
        ],
        "historical_receipts_and_dist_preserved": True,
        "source_stable_across_build_and_verification": True,
        "limitations": [
            (
                "Packaging integrity and dependency-free entrypoints only; "
                "no inference/device/quality/performance check."
            ),
            (
                "The Python inventory includes historical/archive source; "
                "its count is not a maintained-scope validation claim."
            ),
            (
                "Sources reflect only the exact inventoried build snapshot; "
                "later source changes require separate verification."
            ),
            (
                "This receipt and source archive were created after this build "
                "and cannot be included in their own sdist."
            ),
        ],
    }
    with RECEIPT.open("x") as output:
        output.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "receipt": str(RECEIPT),
                "wheel_sha256": digest(wheel),
                "sdist_sha256": digest(sdist),
                "source_count": len(sources),
                "sdist_members": len(members),
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent framework-free verification of local attention preparation evidence."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path('/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat')
RESULTS = ROOT / 'benchmarks/analysis/results'


def obj(value: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    assert isinstance(value, dict)
    return cast(dict[str, object], value)


def sequence(value: object) -> list[object]:
    assert isinstance(value, list)
    return cast(list[object], value)


def unique(items: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
    result: dict[str, object] = {}
    for name, value in items:
        assert name not in result
        result[name] = value
    return result


def nonfinite(token: str) -> object:
    raise ValueError(token)


def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    return obj(json.loads(path.read_bytes(), object_pairs_hook=unique, parse_constant=nonfinite))


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    paths: dict[str, str] = {}
    def pin(path: Path, expected: str | None = None) -> None:
        value = sha(path)
        assert expected is None or value == expected, str(path)
        paths[str(path)] = value
    receipt_path = ROOT / 'benchmarks/real/engine-attention-observer-verification.json'
    pin(receipt_path, '96afbbdf568001c845f4892b4693f07a626911f479d3e99c338cf5657499d27e')
    receipt = read(receipt_path)
    archive_path = Path(cast(str, obj(receipt['source_archive'])['path']))
    pin(archive_path, '59a4f08b99a399841af5e9df8f32a9949fcb3b6ea9f83fb77fc6ba109ccc39ed')
    assert obj(receipt['source_archive'])['sha256'] == paths[str(archive_path)]
    sources = [obj(x) for x in sequence(read(archive_path)['files'])]
    table = obj(receipt['source_sha256'])
    assert len(sources) == len(table) == receipt['maintained_python_files'] == 129
    assert len({x['path'] for x in sources}) == 129
    for source in sources:
        name = cast(str, source['path'])
        value = hashlib.sha256(cast(str, source['text']).encode()).hexdigest()
        assert table[name] == source['sha256'] == value
        pin(ROOT / name, value)
    old_path = ROOT / 'benchmarks/real/engine-unroll-cuda-verification.json'
    pin(old_path)
    old = obj(read(old_path)['source_sha256'])
    assert len(old) == 123
    assert all(table[name] == value for name, value in old.items())
    prior_path = ROOT / 'benchmarks/real/engine-attention-verification.json'
    pin(prior_path)
    prior = obj(read(prior_path)['source_sha256'])
    assert set(prior) == set(table)
    differences = sorted(name for name,value in table.items() if prior[name] != value)
    assert differences == ['benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/study.py', 'benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/trace.py', 'tests/analysis/test_cuda_attention.py']
    pin(RESULTS / 'cuda-attention-local-review.json', '7b903f46d0a93d4ff8bf4f6232f426aaee68e1fbfe2318c66c9433039a5320a8')
    production = {name: value for name, value in table.items() if name.startswith('wyat/')}
    assert len(production) == 20
    assert obj(receipt['production_identity'])['unchanged_files'] == 20
    assert receipt['completed'] is True and receipt['source_bytes_unchanged_after_checks'] is True
    verifier = obj(receipt['verifier'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(cast(str, verifier['text']).encode()).hexdigest() == verifier['sha256']
    checks = obj(receipt['checks'])
    for name, raw in checks.items():
        check = obj(raw)
        assert check['exit_code'] == 0 and check['timed_out'] is False and check['reaped'] is True
        assert float(cast(float, check['seconds'])) < cast(int, check['cap_seconds'])
        assert type(check['pid']) is int and check['stderr'] == ''
        assert isinstance(check['command'], list)
    stdout = cast(str, obj(checks['pytest'])['stdout'])
    assert '777 passed, 1 warning in 10.91s' in stdout and 'skipped' not in stdout and 'failed' not in stdout
    assert obj(checks['pytest'])['cap_seconds'] == 120
    assert obj(checks['ruff_lint'])['stdout'] == 'All checks passed!\n'
    assert obj(checks['ruff_format'])['stdout'] == '135 files already formatted\n'
    assert obj(checks['mypy'])['stdout'] == 'Success: no issues found in 129 source files\n'
    manifest_path = RESULTS / 'cuda-transfer-manifest-v2-20261005.json'
    pin(manifest_path, 'f7d9d7a4755a8df37e7e55d577489a1f9597760a68928b2a8213a0d19d3c6866')
    assets = [obj(x) for x in sequence(read(manifest_path)['files'])]
    assert len(assets) == 44
    for asset in assets:
        path = ROOT / cast(str, asset['path'])
        assert path.stat().st_size == asset['bytes']
        pin(path, cast(str, asset['sha256']))
    declaration_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    pin(declaration_path, sys.argv[2])
    declaration = read(declaration_path)
    assert len(declaration) == 7
    for name, value in declaration.items():
        pin(ROOT / name, cast(str, value))
        if name.endswith('.py'):
            assert table[name] == value
    original_declaration = RESULTS / 'cuda-attention-source-declaration-20261005.json'
    pin(original_declaration, '71f72524e94055a7626dfc1d74af63508dfbb4578d3816090cd79cdf69328ad7')
    original_raw = RESULTS / 'cuda-attention-b1.json'
    pin(original_raw, '80c4c331e891901bc704245177c8d9dae5975881274f5390ef41acad1d420d43')
    pin(RESULTS / 'cuda-attention-b1-review.json', '62a0676e5e0afa51586da31076a2edd0bf159a3570c98a277f4c4f95c244ab9f')
    original_archive_path = RESULTS / 'cuda-attention-b1.sources-766517e920343a96.json'
    pin(original_archive_path, '766517e920343a9637f70a3aeddd251e5808eebb65ae24abe87b3676e022395e')
    original_sources = [obj(x) for x in sequence(read(original_archive_path)['files'])]
    original_table = obj(read(original_raw)['source_sha256'])
    assert len(original_sources) == len(original_table) == 43
    for source in original_sources:
        assert hashlib.sha256(cast(str,source['text']).encode()).hexdigest() == source['sha256'] == original_table[cast(str,source['name'])]
    original_differences = sorted(name for name in declaration if read(original_declaration)[name] != declaration[name])
    assert original_differences == sorted(differences + ['docs/analysis/attention.md'])
    for name, expected in (
        ('cuda-fp32-b1.json', 'd528a44e19ceb6097ea81081d7e57fd97454a26777e45f3a284cb52d044c5167'),
        ('cuda-fp32-b1.wall.json', 'cb00f5f065a04e5c598da04cb3e57a7b75bbaedeb1407dc6ebbb0dd806f4dc8e'),
        ('cuda-fp32-b1-review.json', '1a5d5118549d6e3c0fee67378d859abd269f565d4f3f07a4f1b8f61ebb0f287e'),
        ('cuda-fp32-b1.sources-ae4a797635edfbd1.json', 'ae4a797635edfbd146bd9bd8ce4df436ce599f601c6ab942f3779e4da32308cf'),
    ):
        pin(RESULTS / name, expected)

"""Stdlib owned parent; the worker alone imports the inference framework."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    model: Path
    manifest: Path
    manifest_sha256: str
    sources: Path
    sources_sha256: str
    control: Path
    control_sha256: str
    batch_size: int
    output: Path
    worker: bool


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    for field in ("manifest", "sources", "control"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        return (
            0
            if study(
                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                sources=args.sources,
                sources_sha256=args.sources_sha256,
                control=args.control,
                control_sha256=args.control_sha256,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
            )
            else 1
        )
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.attention.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=(
            "--manifest",
            str(args.manifest),
            "--manifest-sha256",
            args.manifest_sha256,
            "--sources",
            str(args.sources),
            "--sources-sha256",
            args.sources_sha256,
            "--control",
            str(args.control),
            "--control-sha256",
            args.control_sha256,
            "--batch-size",
            str(args.batch_size),
        ),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""First-eight quality and actual dispatch; no ordinary latency verdict."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

import torch
from torch import nn
from transformers import masking_utils
from transformers.integrations import sdpa_attention
from transformers.models.qwen3 import modeling_qwen3

from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.manifest import (
    DATA,
    DATA_SHA,
    INPUT_SHA,
    MODEL_ID,
    REFERENCE,
    ROOT,
    asset_paths,
    digest,
)
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.scorer import FP32Scorer, ieee_precision, require_fp32
from benchmarks.analysis.cuda.study import (
    admit,
    admit_control,
    control_cycle,
    occupancy,
)
from benchmarks.analysis.evidence import freeze_sources
from benchmarks.analysis.reference import read_reference
from wyat import Model
from wyat.backends.kai.artifact import load_artifact
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.benchmark import (
    BenchmarkCycle,
    BenchmarkEngine,
    QualityGate,
    _run,
    compare_cycles,
)
from wyat.core import Scorer
from wyat.evaluation import _input_digest, case_from_dict
from wyat.wire import decode_json, read_object

from .scorer import efficient_scorer
from .trace import efficient_dispatch_gate, profile_batch

SOURCES = (
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/__init__.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/scorer.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/study.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/trace.py"),
    Path("benchmarks/analysis/cuda/attention/run.py"),
    Path("tests/analysis/test_cuda_attention.py"),
    Path("docs/analysis/attention.md"),
)


def admit_sources(path: Path, sha256: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("New source declaration differs from reviewed identity")
    saved = read_object(path)
    if set(saved) != {str(item) for item in SOURCES}:
        raise ValueError("New source declaration must contain every exact source")
    hashes = cast(dict[str, str], saved)
    if any(digest(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in hashes.items()):
        raise ValueError("New experiment source bytes changed")
    return hashes


def check_cycle(
    cycle: BenchmarkCycle,
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    control: BenchmarkCycle,
) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, object]]:
    if tuple(row.id for row in cycle.rows) != tuple(row.id for row in reference.rows):
        raise ValueError("Returned cycle is incomplete or reorders canonical cases")
    cpu_drift = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
    cuda_drift = compare_cycles((control,), (cycle,), QualityGate())
    return cpu_drift.passed and cuda_drift.passed, {
        "cpu_reference": asdict(cpu_drift),
        "cuda_control": asdict(cuda_drift),
    }


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    sources: Path,
    sources_sha256: str,
    control: Path,
    control_sha256: str,
    batch_size: int,
) -> bool:
    if type(batch_size) is not int or batch_size not in (1, 8):
        raise ValueError("First-eight diagnostic requires batch1/8")
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "scope": "first8 pinned BANKING77 training-source; model exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "attention": "FP32 tensor efficient candidate; CUTLASS FastF32, not IEEE",
        "gemm_head": "IEEE global/CUDA matmul; FP32 weights/head, no autocast",
        "limitations": [
            "No speed/promotion claim",
            "Instantaneous occupancy does not reserve hardware",
            "Missing/unstarted outcomes unknown",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    write()
    try:
        if digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256:
            raise ValueError("Original manifest changed")
        admission = admit(manifest)
        source_hashes = admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256)
        pinned = admit_control(
            control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
        )
        hf_policy = {
            "mps_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_mps_available,
            "xpu_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_xpu_available,
            "npu_available": sdpa_attention._is_torch_npu_available,
        }
        payload["hf_availability"] = hf_policy
        if any(hf_policy.values()):
            raise ValueError("Screen requires the frozen Linux CUDA HF policy")
        payload.update(
            admission=admission,
            control=pinned,
            source_declaration_sha256=sources_sha256,
        )
        paths = {
            str(path): ROOT / path
            for path in (*asset_paths(), *SOURCES)
            if path.suffix in (".py", ".md")
        }
        paths.update(
            external_qwen3=Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__),
            external_sdpa=Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
            external_masking=Path(masking_utils.__file__),
        )
        frozen = freeze_sources(paths, output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        if load_artifact(model, 512).model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Model identity differs from frozen control")
        full = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(full) != 77 or _input_digest(full) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Canonical full cohort changed")
        cases = full[:8]
        profiled = cases[:batch_size]
        payload.update(
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            profiled_case_ids=[case.id for case in profiled],
            expected_ordinary_rows=16,
            expected_profile_rows=2 * len(profiled),
        )
        payload["unknown_case_ids"] = {
            f"{name}_{phase}": [case.id for case in selected]
            for name in ("math", "efficient")
            for phase, selected in (("ordinary", cases), ("profile", profiled))
        }
        payload["occupancy_before"] = occupancy()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, full, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda = control_cycle(control, full)
        if not compare_cycles((reference,), (cuda,), QualityGate()).passed:
            raise ValueError("Reviewed CUDA control fails unchanged CPU gates")
        reference, cuda = (
            replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:8]),
            replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:8]),
        )
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
            cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
            base.head.to(base.device)
            require_fp32(base)
            payload["weight_dtypes"] = {
                "backbone": dict(
                    Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.backbone.parameters())
                ),
                "head": dict(Counter(str(p.dtype) for p in base.head.parameters())),
            }
            engines: tuple[tuple[str, Scorer], ...] = (
                ("math", FP32Scorer(base)),
                ("efficient", efficient_scorer(base)),
            )
            for name, scorer in engines:
                chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
                payload["phase"] = f"ordinary_{name}"
                for offset in range(0, len(cases), batch_size):
                    occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                    chunk = _run(
                        BenchmarkEngine(
                            name,
                            Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID),
                            batch_size=batch_size,
                        ),
                        cases[offset : offset + batch_size],
                    )
                    chunks.append(chunk)
                    payload[f"{name}_completed_batches"] = [
                        item.to_dict() for item in chunks
                    ]
                    cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                        f"{name}_ordinary"
                    ] = [
                        case.id
                        for case in cases
                        if case.id
                        not in {row.id for item in chunks for row in item.rows}
                    ]
                    write()
                    if chunk.failed:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{name} ordinary backend/output failure; no profiles"
                        )
                cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
                    sum(item.latency_ms for item in chunks),
                    tuple(row for item in chunks for row in item.rows),
                    chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
                    chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
                )
                payload[f"{name}_cycle"] = cycle.to_dict()
                passed, drift = check_cycle(cycle, reference, cuda)
                payload[f"{name}_drift"] = drift
                write()
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError(f"{name} numerical/rank drift; profiles unstarted")
            for name, scorer in engines:
                occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                payload["phase"] = f"profile_{name}"
                write()
                cycle, trace = profile_batch(scorer, profiled, name=name)
                payload[f"{name}_profile"] = trace
                payload[f"{name}_profile_cycle"] = cycle.to_dict()
                cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                    f"{name}_profile"
                ] = [
                    case.id
                    for case in profiled
                    if case.id not in {row.id for row in cycle.rows}
                ]
                expected = replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[: len(profiled)])
                cuda_expected = replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[: len(profiled)])
                passed, drift = check_cycle(cycle, expected, cuda_expected)
                payload[f"{name}_profile_drift"] = drift
                write()
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError(f"{name} profiled numerical/rank drift")
            length = max(
                len(base.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in profiled
            )
            candidate_trace = cast(dict[str, object], payload["efficient_profile"])
            dispatch_passed = efficient_dispatch_gate(
                candidate_trace,
                batch_size=len(profiled),
                length=length,
            )
            payload["dispatch_passed"] = dispatch_passed
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
        if (
            digest(manifest) != manifest_sha256
            or admit(manifest) != admission
            or admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256) != source_hashes
            or digest(control) != pinned["sha256"]
            or digest(Path(cast(str, pinned["wall_path"]))) != pinned["wall_sha256"]
            or any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Consumed identity/source changed during diagnostics")
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=True,
            phase="completed",
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
        )
        write()
        return dispatch_passed
    except Exception as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        return False
